title: exec-staff-meeting-prep-notes-2026-03-25
content:
Exec staff sync — prep notes (wip)
Date: 2026-03-25 09:00 PT (30m)
Attendees: Priya (CEO), Samir (CTO), Elena (VP Product), Marcus (CRO), + optional: Ops/Finance for capacity discussion

Top goals for this sync:
- Quick alignment on top company risks (latency/cost, Dedicated ramp, Private deals pipeline)
- Decide canary plan for Dedicated capacity rollout next week
- Confirm priority for Optima (cost/perf) launch gating items and metrics
- Review any exec-level escalations (customer outage, legal/compliance asks)

Agenda (proposed, tight):
1) 3m: quick wins / shout-outs
2) 7m: Operational highlight — serving runtime SLOs / recent incident summary (Samir)
   - Incident recap: 2026-03-22 degraded throughput in us-west-2 for 2h due to kernel regression; mitigation = rollback + hotfix queued
   - Current status: hotfix PR merged to staging; rollout plan 03-26 canary (low risk)
   - Ask: agree rollback vs staged kernel swap for dedicated pools?
3) 8m: Product & GTM priorities (Elena + Marcus)
   - Dedicated: canary timeline, list of high-traffic tenants to avoid during canary, SLA language finalization
   - Private: 2 deals in legal review (Acme Health, FinCo) — ask: pricing floor approval and resource commitment for on-prem staging
   - Optimize: metrics to include in Beta dashboard (token-cost delta, avg latency by model, quality regressions)
4) 7m: People / resourcing + hiring updates (Priya)
   - Hiring: SRE reqs (2 ICs), Product Ops manager candidate feedback, timeline to close
   - Prioritization ask: do we freeze new non-customer projects for 2 weeks to focus on Dedicated launch?
5) 5m: Actions & risks — confirm owners and due dates

Notes / talking points (scratch):
- Incident: need clearer rollback playbook for kernel-level changes. Ops to produce 1-page runbook (Samir).
- Dedicated canary: prefer phased canary by customer tier (internal -> alpha customers -> paid tenants) to limit blast radius. Marcus to provide list of alpha customers and contact owners.
- Billing/pricing for Private: Marcus suggests 20% uplift for on-prem support + 3-month minimum commitment. Finance wants template contract language from legal.
- Optimize launch: Elena asks for "quality delta" gating metric (no more than 2% ordinal drop on eval set). Samir: run quant + kernel matrix tests and report by EOD 03-27.
- Observability gaps: tracing from request->batch currently missing correlation id in Dedicated. SRE ticket created ENG-7922; target 03-30.

Decisions to make in meeting:
- Approve Dedicated canary plan: staged by tier, start 03-26, monitor 48h windows per stage. (Decision needed)
- Approve pricing floor for Private pilot deals (Acme Health, FinCo) — Marcus to propose numbers.
- Freeze non-customer-facing projects for two weeks? (Priya to propose scope)

Action items (owner / due) — short, exec-followup friendly:
- Samir: Share 1-page kernel rollback runbook + canary checklist. Due: 2026-03-26.
- Marcus: Send list of alpha customers (and their SRE contacts) for canary sequencing. Due: 2026-03-25 EOD.
- Elena: Finalize Optimize gating criteria and publish Beta dashboard spec. Due: 2026-03-27.
- Finance (lead: Ana Gomez): Draft pricing floor + commercial terms for Private pilot. Due: 2026-03-28.
- Ops (lead: Marcus + Samir): Confirm Dedicated pool capacity reservations for next 6 weeks and cost impact estimate. Due: 2026-03-27.
- Priya: Confirm hiring freeze scope & communicate to people ops. Due: 2026-03-26.

Follow-ups for next exec sync (04-01):
- Canary status + metrics (latency, error rate, token cost)
- Private pilot deal signatures + resource commitments
- Hiring pipeline progress for SRE and Product Ops

Open questions / talk-leftovers:
- Do we need an emergency channel for cross-org canary issues? Slack channel vs PagerDuty escalation? (Samir to propose)
- Legal: any changes required for SLA wording in Dedicated contracts for canary customers? (Ana / legal)

Quick links / refs:
- Incident timeline: ENG-PR-2026-03-22 (internal tracker)
- Dedicated deployment plan (draft): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/Dedicated+Canary+Plan
- Private pilot term sheet template: https://drive.redwood.ai/privates/term-sheet-v3.docx

Notes to self: keep meeting tight, surface only decisions and blockers. Call out any escalations that require CEO sign-off (pricing, legal concessions).

End of prep (wip).
